groups.defect: The sync branch returns a raw fetch Response while consumers expect SDK response objects or parsed token payloads.
groups.rationale: These describe the same return-shape mismatch at the shared helper and its consumers. Google's undefined .data access is a concrete manifestation of the defect reported by the other members.

groups.defect: Google Calendar persists the safeParse result wrapper instead of its parsed credential data.
groups.rationale: Every member identifies the same assignment and database write, with the same resulting malformed credential. Unwrapping .data at this location resolves all five reports.

groups.defect: Zoho Bigin passes the credential row ID as the user ID sent to the credential-sync endpoint.
groups.rationale: All four report the identical incorrect third argument to refreshOAuthTokens and require the same correction.

groups.defect: The minimum token schema uses ineffective computed keys and strips expiry and other token fields, while the parser injects a literal refresh_token placeholder that overwrites stored refresh tokens.
groups.rationale: The schema reports overlap on discarded fields, and the placeholder reports overlap on refresh-token corruption. s_f0d1f649 explicitly reports both defects, joining them into one group whose merged comment must preserve both.
